metrics.method: Read all 161 lines by hand (51 client messages). Client questions = distinct requests or instructions from Alanna<3. Unanswered >24h counts any with no substantive team reply within 24h: the 8/19 live-pause instruction (never answered), the 9/10 photo handover (~3.3d, generic ack) and the 9/12 sexting set (~30h). Team silence = largest gap between consecutive non-client, non-service messages, computed by script (8/17 19:31 -> 8/26 19:17). Promises = explicit 'we will / I'll' commitments by our side. Kept means a delivery is visible in chat (release sent, trailer sorted, domain delivered, invoicing started, Zelle request 10/4). Partial means delivered late or irregularly (weekly reports, weekly creative ideas). Lapsed means no delivery or a failure (impersonator takedown, customs push report, Calendly kickoff, new IG account, Drive-ingestion proof, 9/23 Zelle).
